# Seek Media

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Seeks in the current media.

## Syntax

~~~~text
seek(behavior: <#Enumeration (WFSeekBehavior)#>, time: <#Time Span#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
seek(behavior: Forward By, time: 1 minute)
~~~~
